item.title: A message from Mr. Vonesch:
item.description: Need a place to casually interact with ideas and share your thoughts? The philosophy and debate club will get together every Tuesday at 10:50am in the chapel for high school students to engage in critical thinking and to socialize

item.title: A message from Mr. Cornellier:
item.description: Any girls in grades 9 and 10 who are interested in weekly volleyball sessions are asked to come out on Wednesdays after school, from 2:20-3:45. This is an excellent opportunity to get ready for tryouts. Please see Mr. Cornellier if you have any questions.

item.title: A message from Mme Plourde:
item.description: There will be a WEB meeting in room 146 at 9:05 am. Thank you!

item.title: A message from Ms. Brennan.
item.description: Calling all gardeners and outdoor enthusiasts! Are you looking for an excuse to get outside and get your hands dirty? Join members of the garden club for the first of three fall cleanup sessions, this Wednesday from 2:20 until 3:20. Get some fresh air and earn volunteer hours. Stop by room 201 for more information.

item.title: A Message from Mme Perron.
item.description: There will be a brief Europe Team meeting today at lunch in room 125 all travelers must attend. Please bring any items collected for trivia night.

item.title: A message from Mr. Benoit:
item.description: Girls 7&8 soccer tryouts start today after school until 3:20. Boys 7&8 tryouts will be tomorrow after school until 3:20 as well.
